title: Calendar
description: Fiori calendar: day / month / year / year-range pickers, single, multiple or range selection, week numbers, special days and legend, the SAP keyboard model. Gregorian, Intl-based.

usage.summary: Select Gregorian dates in a calendar that remains visible.
useWhen: Let users select one or more dates while keeping a calendar visible.
Keep month and year navigation available when users need calendar context.
Use selectionMode="multiple" for separate days or range for a contiguous interval; bound choices with minDate and maxDate.

avoidWhen.when: Enter one localized date in a compact field with an on-demand calendar.
Enter a contiguous date range in a compact field.
Enter both a date and a time in one field.
